slices.focus: Considering low-maintenance houseplants after a social visit sparks desire for a less bare, more lived-in home
slices.summary: After Priya drags her to a soup swap, Hannah decides to buy a pothos (not a cat — that's still for a future, less chaotic life) as a small experiment in making her cluttered apartment feel more inhabited and less like a storage annex.
open_loops: Buy one pothos using existing pot, not new one
Ask Priya which windowsill gets decent light
Make soup at home one night this week rather than eating desk meals
decisions: Hannah still wants a cat someday, but she now sees low-maintenance houseplants as a better fit for her current cluttered
